name: Lampheart
description: Gain 1 Frenzy the first time you would take damage on your turn and again on the enemies’ turn, even if Block absorbs it. Direct life loss gives zero Frenzy. Frenzy resets each fight.
trigger: First positive damage on each side’s turn

name: Flint Shim
description: The first left face you play each turn gets +1 Damage or Block.

name: Reed Shuttle
description: Gain 2 Block when you play your third face each turn.

name: Clay Weir
description: Gain 2 Block when you commit dice with a blank showing.

name: Mud Wedge
description: Gain 2 Block the first time you reroll a blank each turn.

name: Thread Spool
description: Gain 1 Block the first time you play a right or rightmost face each turn.

name: Wax Balance
description: Gain 3 Block after playing both a top and a bottom face in the same turn. Once per turn.

name: Knotted Cord
description: Gain 2 Block the first time you play a face with at least 5 Damage or Block pips each turn.

name: Silt Quill
description: The first time you play a face with exactly 1 Damage or Block pip each turn, your next Damage or Block face gets +1 pip.

name: Keeper’s Bead
description: At the end of your turn, gain 1 Ward per unused reroll.

name: Pocket Spring
description: Gain one extra reroll on turns 3, 6, 9, and so on.

name: Cold Pebble
description: Apply 1 Weak to every enemy at the start of combat.

name: Twin Rivets
description: Gain 2 Block when you commit two playable faces from the same position.

name: Sedge Laces
description: Gain 1 Ward when you play your first top face each turn.

name: Fen Tongs
description: Gain 2 Block the first time you remove all of an enemy’s Block with a face each turn.

name: Silt Salt
description: Gain 2 Block the first time you play a face with enemy Burn, Poison, Weak, or Vulnerable each turn.

name: Hinge Pin
description: The first time a reroll lands on a blank each turn, reroll that die one more time for free.
trigger: First blank landed on a reroll

name: Reed Loom
description: The first time you play a Damage or Block face from a position you already played this turn, add 2 pips to it.

name: Loop Weight
description: If you committed without rerolling, your first face played this turn gets +2 Damage or Block.
trigger: First face with no rerolls used

name: Drowned Compass
description: On even turns, if you played no middle face, apply 1 Weak to the healthiest enemy before enemies act.

name: Tide Knot
description: Gain 4 Ward after playing both a left and a rightmost face in the same turn. Once per turn.

name: Blank Ferrule
description: At commit, the first blank showing becomes a 3 Block face for that turn.

name: Clay Flask
description: Gain 4 Ward the first time damage lowers your HP in each fight.

name: Iron Thread
description: The fourth face you play each turn gets +2 Damage or Block.

name: Mire Glass
description: If your first face played each turn has at least 3 Damage or Block pips, deal 2 damage to the healthiest surviving enemy.

name: Tide Slate
description: The first time you remove all of a surviving enemy’s Block with a face each turn, apply 1 Burn and 1 Vulnerable to it.

name: Counterweight Crown
description: Your first face played from each of the right and rightmost positions gets +3 Damage or Block each turn.
trigger: First face at each right-side position

name: Sixfold Bell
description: When you play faces from four different positions in a turn, gain 6 Block and deal 6 damage to the healthiest surviving enemy. Once per turn.

name: Floodgate Key
description: On turns 3, 6, 9, and so on, your first three faces played get +3 Damage or Block each.
trigger: First three faces on every third turn

name: Hollow Prism
description: If you commit with a blank showing, your first two Damage or Block faces played this turn each get +2 pips.

name: Twinwake Dial
description: Play two faces in a row with the same positive Damage or Block pips to give all other unused dice +1 pip this turn. Once per turn.
